body: SCOUT RECON FOR QUEUED bd-01M16BPV38CMQ74963BCGCAPGN — no edits before current route candidate lands. Two source facts sharpen the required three-way split. (1) induce builds classes as graph.ordered.map(id -> classify), and classify is total, so classes.get(u.id)==None is not an ordinary current-production path; it is an invariant/pipeline break that still deserves an adversarial regression. (2) specificity is built with details.flatMap(graph.byId.get), so source-unit-absent currently omits the DetailId entirely; assess then has a second lookup fallback, though assess against the same graph skips that detail even earlier. Proposed production shape: build specificity over EVERY input detail, not flatMap. For source absent, store typed Missing(SourceUnitAbsent); for source present but class lookup absent, Missing(Unclassified); for literal UnitClass.Uninterpretable, Missing(ClassifiedUninterpretable). Then assess must not synthesize zero if a malformed/external InductionResult lacks an entry; it should preserve a fourth pipeline-omission reason or refuse, rather than mislabel omission as source absence. Vocabulary question before edit: MissingReason currently has no Custom case and adding three interview-specific cases to the portable generic enum also forces codec/law scope. I prefer an explicit extensible MissingReason.Custom(namespace,label), mirroring UndefinedReason.Custom/MalformedReason.Custom, with package-level constants for these three reasons and codec round-trip tests; that obeys the typed Custom escape hatch without polluting the generic closed vocabulary. Alternative is three new generic cases. Chief: please choose/authorize the vocabulary and clarify whether the other classified non-content UnitClass cases (Metacognitive/Evaluative/Repair/TaskCommentary/Association/Inference) remain observed 0.0, become Excluded, or share the classified-uninterpretable absence. The current catch-all conflates all seven.
